title: Limitations on testamentary disposition.
bodyText: This part does not authorize a person to dispose of property by will if it is held under limitations imposed by law preventing testamentary disposition by that person.
bodyHtml: §510-29  Limitations on testamentary disposition.  This part does not authorize a person to dispose of property by will if it is held under limitations imposed by law preventing testamentary disposition by that person. [L 1973, c 132, pt of §1]
